data.bottom_line: Near and above treeline, you can trigger an avalanche that is large enough to injure and bury you. Slopes that face the north half of the compass, and are steeper than about 30 degrees are the most suspect. Give slopes where recent storms drifted snow a wide berth; you might trigger them from above, next to, or below. Seek out wind-sheltered areas and slopes below treeline for safer travel options.
